title: Design System: Xat — Design Engineer Portfolio

shadows.name: shadow-halo
shadows.purpose: The single signature shadow. Rose-tinted halo on highlight-surface (cards, intro badges, popovers) and surface-callout (asides). Color cascades through --tw-shadow-color so utility overrides recolor without redefining geometry.

shadows.name: shadow-image-edge
shadows.purpose: Article media edge. A shadow-drawn 1px ink hairline plus the signature halo, used on screenshots and illustrations so images feel held by the page without becoming cards.

shadows.name: popover
shadows.purpose: Floating layer shadow for popovers and hover cards.

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: Default easing for reveals, transitions, and state changes. Ease-out-quart.

motion.name: ease-coin-flip
motion.purpose: Strong ease-in-out for the design-page mascot coin flip.

motion.name: ease-wanderer
motion.purpose: Alternating gradient flow for footer wanderer text.

motion.name: duration-reveal
motion.purpose: Page reveal and stagger entrance duration.

motion.name: duration-hover
motion.purpose: Color and border transitions on interactive elements.

narrative.overview: The system is engineering precision wearing a soft glow. The bones are an austere mono-ink grid — paper-white in light, deep blue-tinted ink in dark — whose page structure comes from spacing, rhythm, and typographic alignment. Hairlines appear only where a bounded surface needs an edge. The accent is Quiet Rose in light mode and Warm Apricot in dark, used on no more than ~10% of any screen. The 'Cute' lives in specific, named places: the Fugaz One wordmark, the coin-flip mascot, the wanderer gradient footer. The 'Shiny' is the soft pink halo under interactive surfaces. The 'Elegance' is the trilingual typography stack tuned with per-locale breaking rules.
keyCharacteristics: Mono-ink + one accent (≤10% of any screen)
Spacing-first structure; hairlines for bounded surfaces

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: highlight-text and highlight-soft together occupy ≤10% of any rendered screen. The accent's rarity is the point.

rules.name: The Boundaries-Not-Walls Rule
rules.body: In light mode, surface, card, and popover all collapse to background. Components that need containment exist as lightly bordered regions, while page sections remain open and are separated by spacing.

rules.name: The Code Stays Dark Rule
rules.body: Code surfaces never switch palette. Vesper is the code identity.

rules.name: The Trilingual Wrap Rule
rules.body: Every block of body copy has explicit per-locale text breaking rules.

rules.name: The One Wordmark Rule
rules.body: font-fugaz-one is forbidden anywhere except on the literal text 'Xat'.

rules.name: The One Gradient Rule
rules.body: background-clip: text gradient appears in exactly one place: the footer wanderer-gradient-text.

rules.name: The Whisper-Only Rule
rules.body: Every shadow is tinted with highlight-soft at <50% opacity. Pure black shadows are forbidden in light mode.

rules.name: The Border-First Rule
rules.body: When a bounded surface needs separation, try a hairline border before a shadow. Use whitespace for page structure.

dos: Do keep highlight-text and highlight-soft below ~10% of any rendered screen.
Do use OKLCH for every color token.
Do tint shadows with highlight-soft in light mode.
Do carry page structure with spacing, rhythm, and alignment; reserve hairlines for bounded surfaces.
Do use text-wrap: balance on Latin headings and text-wrap: wrap on Japanese headings.
Do wrap prime-component customization in src/components/, not src/components/ui/.
Do use transition-colors duration-150 ease-out as the default transition.
Do start every motion with cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1).
donts: Don't use font-fugaz-one anywhere except on the literal string 'Xat'.
Don't add another background-clip: text gradient.
Don't add backdrop-filter: blur() as a decorative layer.
Don't use border-left or border-right greater than 1px as a colored accent stripe.
Don't use Fraunces, Cormorant, Playfair, Inter, DM Sans, IBM Plex, Space Grotesk, or Outfit.
Don't lay out pages as centered-stack hero with identical icon-title-text cards.
Don't reach for a modal as the first thought.
Don't use uppercase letter-spaced labels as section eyebrows.
Don't style code blocks to follow the site theme.
